text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin JF. The hype is 
totally unreal, making Daitaku Helios 
realize that GⅠ is just on a whole 'nother 
level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the other runners were totally 
put off by her party-girl vibe. Even so, 
Daitaku Helios hyped them up saying a 
festival's gotta be lit, setting 
everyone's spirits ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Declaring that she's the hottest party 
animal today no matter what, Daitaku 
Helios heads to the race in super-high 
spirits.
